scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p services/tickets --noEmit && tsc -p services/assist --noEmit && tsc -p frontend --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: bun test packages/shared/tests/unit && bun run --cwd services/tickets test && bun run --cwd services/assist test && bun test frontend/tests/unit
scripts.db:setup: bun run --cwd services/tickets prisma:generate && bun run --cwd services/tickets db:setup && bun run --cwd services/assist prisma:generate && bun run --cwd services/assist db:setup
scripts.db:seed: bun run --cwd services/tickets db:seed && bun run --cwd services/assist db:seed
scripts.test:integration: bun run --cwd services/tickets test:integration && bun run --cwd services/assist test:integration
